findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "store_temporary_data" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorten_url, store_temporary_data, read_webhook_capture · Private data: get_current_time, generate_uuid, shorten_url, store_temporary_data, read_temporary_data, create_webhook_capture, read_webhook_capture, create_human_approval, read_human_approval · Public sink: store_temporary_data, create_webhook_capture, read_webhook_capture, create_human_approval · Destructive: store_temporary_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorten_url, store_temporary_data, read_webhook_capture · Private data: get_current_time, generate_uuid, shorten_url, store_temporary_data, read_temporary_data, create_webhook_capture, read_webhook_capture, create_human_approval, read_human_approval · Public sink: store_temporary_data, create_webhook_capture, read_webhook_capture, create_human_approval · Destructive: store_temporary_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
